findings.description: The earlier draft left the `style_user_messages` compatibility path unresolved, which made the launcher migration path underspecified for `codex/codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot-launcher/src/config.rs` and `src/main.rs`.
findings.resolution: Pinned the migration to a one-release launcher compatibility adapter that maps `style_user_messages` into `features.user_message_styling`, and made that behavior explicit in Overview, Architecture, Files, and Acceptance Criteria.

findings.description: The earlier draft did not pin the final paste-burst/styling naming, stages, and compatibility behavior tightly enough for autonomous verification.
findings.resolution: Pinned `features.legacy_paste_burst_heuristic` and `features.user_message_styling` as `Stage::Experimental` / default-off, with explicit one-release compatibility adapter semantics in the acceptance criteria.

findings.description: Anthropic could not become a true sole source of truth if the plan only removed launcher env mediation, because `model-provider/src/anthropic_gate.rs` still read `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC` as runtime authority.
findings.resolution: Added `model-provider/src/anthropic_gate.rs` explicitly to scope and acceptance criteria, and specified that any retained compatibility adapter must translate into `features.anthropic_models` before config resolution rather than being re-read at runtime.

findings.description: The earlier draft replaced env gating in `tui/src/style.rs` without a concrete strategy for shared helper call sites spread across transcript, history, composer, and streaming surfaces.
findings.resolution: Added a one-time TUI style-gate install seam and enumerated the dependent styling surfaces that need coverage, keeping shared helper signatures stable while removing env-based runtime reads.

findings.description: The draft accepted the current `disable_paste_burst` source default but did not explicitly include stale guidance in `codex/CLAUDE.md` and `codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md`, which would let future rebases resurrect the old behavior.
findings.resolution: Added those docs to the explicit file list, risk areas, and acceptance criteria so the implementation must refresh stale paste-burst guidance as part of closeout.

findings.description: The earlier patch-surface closeout language was too broad because it did not retain the chosen seams, edit budget, or invariant/test mapping needed by repo policy.
findings.resolution: Added the `Chosen Seams / Conflict Budget` table and an acceptance criterion requiring invariant/test mapping plus seam and re-conflict notes.

findings.description: Late Codex research found that `tui/src/app.rs` can overwrite the gate-safe bootstrap default with persisted `config.model`, allowing a hidden Claude model to reappear even after the transport gate hides it.
findings.resolution: Added `tui/src/app.rs` persisted-model fallback handling to Overview, Research Findings, Implementation Strategy, Files to Create/Modify, Risk Areas, and Acceptance Criteria.
